items.q: Are hardwoods always harder than softwoods?
items.correct: No — the terms refer to the tree type, not actual hardness (balsa is a soft hardwood).
items.why: Hardwoods come from broadleaved (deciduous) trees, softwoods from conifers — regardless of hardness.

items.q: Can thermosetting plastics be remelted and reshaped?
items.correct: No — thermosetting plastics set permanently; thermoforming ones can be reshaped with heat.
items.misconception: Yes, all plastics can be remelted repeatedly.
items.random_wrong: Thermoforming plastics set hard and can never be reshaped.
items.why: Thermoforming (thermoplastic) types soften on heating; thermosetting types undergo a permanent change.
